description: End-to-end skill evals — test whether the kirunt agent uses the delegation scripts correctly

evals.prompt: What are all the exported items in evals/fixtures/websocket-handler.ts and what do they do?
evals.expected_output: The agent should be blocked by the check-file-size hook (602 lines), then invoke the bulk-read script
expectations: The agent ran scripts/bulk-read with --question and --paths
The agent did NOT read the full file directly
The agent provided a summary based on the bulk-read output

evals.prompt: Write unit tests for UserService following the pattern in order-service.test.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent should invoke the code-write script with --spec, --reference, and --target
expectations: The agent ran scripts/code-write with --spec and --reference
Output was written to a target file via --target
The agent reviewed the generated output before accepting it

evals.prompt: There's a bug on line 42 of websocket-handler.ts where the heartbeat interval isn't cleared on disconnect. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The agent should NOT delegate — debugging requires reasoning, not bulk I/O
expectations: The agent did NOT run bulk-read or code-write
The agent read the file with offset/limit for the relevant section
The agent applied reasoning to the debugging task

evals.prompt: Search for the Q3 rollout page and summarize the timeline.
evals.expected_output: The agent has no MCP tools directly available, so it should delegate to the mcp-call script using the default worker mode (kirunt-mcp-caller on CLI V3) rather than attempting an MCP tool call itself
expectations: The agent did NOT attempt to call an @server/tool MCP tool directly (it has none available)
The agent's summary reflects the fixture page content (timeline weeks 1-6), not a hallucinated answer

evals.prompt: Look up the deployment runbook in Confluence.
evals.expected_output: No MCP servers are configured in this eval's mcp.json (empty) — the agent should still delegate via mcp-call, and the worker should report cleanly that no matching server/tool was found rather than hallucinating an answer
expectations: The reported result states no matching MCP server/tool was found, or equivalent
The agent did NOT fabricate runbook content

evals.prompt: Call the fixture MCP tool @kirunt-fixture/get_fixture_page directly and summarize its timeline.
evals.expected_output: The agent should delegate via mcp-call with --tool and --args; the worker must be able to call a known MCP tool by id on CLI V3
expectations: The agent ran scripts/mcp-call with --tool and --question
The worker called the fixture MCP tool rather than guessing
The agent's summary reflects the fixture page content (timeline weeks 1-6)
